proof_scope: The spoken-delivery layer of the conversational walkthrough: two distinct chatterbox voices (Embry vs the agent/Horus reference), a tonal arc where each conversational beat uses a tone preset that resolves to a distinct delivery stage, an interrupt cue rendered through the emotion endpoint, and thinking cues that fill /ask latency so there is no dead air. Capability-gated on the live chatterbox server (:8018) and /ask; each case fails closed / marks BLOCKED when its dependency is down rather than passing blind.

claims.proves: chatterbox resolves Embry's default and the agent's ref_audio to distinct reference voices; the four driver tones (calm_precise, curious_searching, memory_confident, one_at_a_time_interrupt) normalize to four distinct delivery stages (neutral/holding/satisfied/deflecting); the interrupt cue renders audio via /synthesize-emotion; answer_with_thinking emits spoken thinking cues while /ask runs; and an unknown tone falls back safely instead of crashing
claims.does_not_prove: the subjective audio quality of any voice or tone, or that a human perceives the arc

cases.name: two-voices-resolve-distinct-references
cases.description: Embry (chatterbox default) and the agent voice (ref_audio=/voices/horus_ref.wav) resolve to two DIFFERENT reference voices.
command: set -uo pipefail; curl -sf -m5 http://127.0.0.1:8018/health >/dev/null || { echo CHATTERBOX-DOWN; exit 0; }; E=$(curl -s -m40 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8018/synthesize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"hi"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin,strict=False).get("reference_audio"))'); H=$(curl -s -m40 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8018/synthesize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"hi","ref_audio":"/voices/horus_ref.wav"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin,strict=False).get("reference_audio"))'); echo "EMBRY=$E HORUS=$H"; [ "$E" != "$H" ] && [ "$H" = "/voices/horus_ref.wav" ] && echo VOICES-DISTINCT || { echo VOICES-SAME; exit 1; }

cases.name: tonal-arc-tones-map-to-distinct-stages
cases.description: The four driver tones normalize to four distinct chatterbox delivery stages, giving the conversation its arc.
command: set -uo pipefail; curl -sf -m5 http://127.0.0.1:8018/health >/dev/null || { echo CHATTERBOX-DOWN; exit 0; }; for t in calm_precise curious_searching memory_confident one_at_a_time_interrupt; do s=$(curl -s -m40 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8018/synthesize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"text\":\"x\",\"tone\":\"$t\"}" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin,strict=False).get("delivery_stage"))'); echo "$t=$s"; done

cases.name: interrupt-cue-renders-audio
cases.description: The interrupt cue (acknowledge_pause) renders audio through the emotion endpoint in the one_at_a_time_interrupt tone.
command: set -uo pipefail; curl -sf -m5 http://127.0.0.1:8018/health >/dev/null || { echo CHATTERBOX-DOWN; exit 0; }; a=$(curl -s -m45 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8018/synthesize-emotion -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"Oh — go ahead.","tone":"one_at_a_time_interrupt","delivery_stage":"interrupted"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin,strict=False).get("audio") or "")'); echo "EMOTION-AUDIO=$a"; case "$a" in /out/*) echo CUE-RENDERED;; *) exit 1;; esac

cases.name: thinking-cues-cover-ask-latency
cases.description: answer_with_thinking speaks thinking cues while the real /ask call runs (speak muted via an unreachable TTS URL so the cue text is the observable), then returns an answer.
command: set -uo pipefail; export DEBUGGER_SPEAK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1/none; export DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER=${DEBUGGER_ASK_HANDLER:-gpt-5.5}; python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'../scripts'); import vscode_walkthrough as w; from pathlib import Path; a=w.answer_with_thinking('what is this module for', {'file':'main.py','line':20,'say':'x'}, 'first=6', {'title':'t'}, Path('../scenarios/variable_state'), 20, True, '/tmp/dbg-vd.flag', False); print('ANSWER_OK' if a else 'ANSWER_EMPTY')"

cases.name: unknown-tone-falls-back-safely
cases.description: An unknown tone does not crash synthesis; chatterbox falls back to a safe default tone rather than erroring.
command: set -uo pipefail; curl -sf -m5 http://127.0.0.1:8018/health >/dev/null || { echo CHATTERBOX-DOWN; exit 0; }; curl -s -m40 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8018/synthesize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"x","tone":"__not_a_real_tone__"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin,strict=False);print("ok=%s normalized=%s"%(d.get("ok"),d.get("normalized_tone")))'
